files.purpose: Configure Jac 0.36.1 [project] with name, description and entry-point main.jac; this headless slice has no npm, plugin or AI dependencies.

Graph data model, no imports. node HubNode { has name: str = "Nourish Hub"; }. node BusinessNode with name, location, business_type, contact (all str, no defaults). node ShelterNode with name: str, location: str, current_capacity: int, max_capacity: int, needed_items: list[str] (no defaults). node DonationNode with food_type: str, quantity: int, expiry_time: str, status: str = "pending" (lifecycle pending -> matched -> completed), dispatched: bool = False. node VolunteerNode with name, vehicle_type, location, contact (str) and is_available: bool = True. Empty typed edges: Offers (BusinessNode -> DonationNode), AllocatedTo (DonationNode -> ShelterNode), AssignedVolunteer (DonationNode -> VolunteerNode), ConnectedToHub (domain node -> HubNode).

signatures.HubNode: node HubNode { has name: str = "Nourish Hub"; }
signatures.BusinessNode: node BusinessNode { has name: str; has location: str; has business_type: str; has contact: str; }
signatures.ShelterNode: node ShelterNode { has name: str; has location: str; has current_capacity: int; has max_capacity: int; has needed_items: list[str]; }
signatures.DonationNode: node DonationNode { has food_type: str; has quantity: int; has expiry_time: str; has status: str = "pending"; has dispatched: bool = False; }
signatures.VolunteerNode: node VolunteerNode { has name: str; has vehicle_type: str; has location: str; has contact: str; has is_available: bool = True; }

files.purpose: Imports datetime from datetime and BusinessNode, DonationNode, Offers from services.nourish_model (absolute import path). walker supply_manager has payload food_type: str, quantity: int, expiry_time: str (zero-padded ISO-8601 like 2025-12-31T18:00:00) and result fields created_donation: DonationNode | None = None, error_message: str = "". Ability process_business runs with BusinessNode entry on here (the business). Step 1: now_str = datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"); if expiry_time <= now_str (plain string comparison) set error_message to exactly f"REJECTED: Food '{food_type}' from '{business name}' is already expired (expiry={expiry_time}).", print it prefixed with "[SupplyAgent] ", report {"status": "error", "message": error_message} and disengage (no node or edge is created). Step 2 otherwise: build DonationNode(food_type, quantity, expiry_time, status="pending", dispatched=False), connect business +>:Offers():+> donation, also root ++> donation, set created_donation to it, print a log line, report exactly {"status": "created", "business": business name, "food_type": food_type, "quantity": quantity, "expiry_time": expiry_time} (keys in that order) and disengage. Exactly one report per spawn.

signatures.supply_manager: walker supply_manager { has food_type: str; has quantity: int; has expiry_time: str; has created_donation: DonationNode | None = None; has error_message: str = ""; can process_business with BusinessNode entry; }

files.purpose: Thin entry point with only imports: HubNode, BusinessNode, ShelterNode, DonationNode, VolunteerNode, Offers, AllocatedTo, AssignedVolunteer, ConnectedToHub from services.nourish_model and supply_manager from services.supply_agent; no UI route.

verify.flow: create business -> spawn supply_manager -> inspect report, created_donation and Offers/root edges
verify.steps: Run jac check main.jac and Jac behavior tests for valid uploads, Offers and root wiring, expired-food rejection and model defaults.

assumption: Backend slice of Viktor-Nedev/Nourish: the graph model and the supply agent walker. The REST dashboard module, the self-contained demo script, client pages and the JSX entry point are out of scope; main.jac is a thin new import module.
